author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
I finally take the effort to setup my AI chief of staff. I let a 6.1 Sol low model as my chief of staff baby sitting my 10+ Codex/Claude Code agents, which has numbers of sub-agents of their own.

Best of all, ChatGPT real time voice chat is pretty amazing, I can talk to my chief of staff like a real human.

I found that 10 agents is probably the limit of a chief of staff can handle. If I have more agents than that, the chief of staff would take forever to make any decisions.
